catalog.name: Flood Monitoring
catalog.description: Near real-time flood detection and monitoring products from NASA satellite missions providing critical information for disaster response, emergency management, and flood risk assessment. These datasets help identify flooded areas globally within hours of data acquisition.

info.name: Attribution
info.content: Data from NASA MODIS missions on Terra and Aqua satellites. MODIS Flood Products developed by NASA Goddard Space Flight Center. Contact: earthdata-support@nasa.gov

info.name: License
info.content: NASA data is generally available for public use. These products are designed for disaster response and emergency management applications.

info.name: Emergency Applications
info.content: Disaster response coordination, emergency evacuation planning, flood extent mapping, damage assessment, insurance claims support, humanitarian aid deployment.

info.name: Update Frequency
info.content: Near real-time products updated within 2-4 hours of satellite overpass, with daily composites for comprehensive flood monitoring.

members.name: MODIS Near Real-Time Flood Detection
members.description: Near real-time global flood products from MODIS instruments providing rapid flood detection for emergency response and disaster management.

members.name: MODIS Flood Product NRT (Daily)
members.description: Daily near real-time global flood detection from combined MODIS Terra and Aqua satellites, providing rapid identification of flooded areas for emergency response.

info.name: Background
info.content: The MODIS Near Real-Time Global Flood Product (MCDWD) automatically detects flood water using MODIS surface reflectance imagery. The algorithm identifies water pixels and compares them to historical water occurrence to detect anomalous flooding.

info.name: Detection Method
info.content: Uses normalized difference water index (NDWI) and other spectral indices to identify water surfaces, then compares to historical baseline to detect flood anomalies

info.name: Spatial Resolution
info.content: 250m spatial resolution for maximum detail in flood extent mapping

info.name: Temporal Coverage
info.content: 2012 to present, with daily global coverage

info.name: Latency
info.content: Near real-time processing with 2-4 hour latency from satellite overpass

info.name: Product Classification
info.content: Water (including flood water), Non-water, No data (clouds, shadows), and quality flags for confidence assessment

info.name: Emergency Response Value
info.content: Rapid flood extent mapping, damage assessment support, evacuation planning, emergency resource allocation, international disaster response coordination

info.name: Limitations
info.content: Cloud cover can limit detection, best performance in areas with significant water extent, may miss flooding under dense vegetation canopy

info.name: Attribution
info.content: NASA MODIS mission team, NASA Goddard Space Flight Center Hydrological Sciences Laboratory

members.name: MODIS Flood Product NRT (2-Day Composite)
members.description: 2-day composite near real-time flood product combining multiple MODIS observations to reduce cloud gaps and improve flood detection reliability.

info.name: Background
info.content: The 2-day composite combines MODIS observations over a 2-day period to reduce the impact of clouds and provide more complete spatial coverage of flood events.

info.name: Composite Advantages
info.content: Reduced cloud gaps, improved spatial coverage, more robust flood detection through temporal aggregation, better continuity of flood extent mapping

info.name: Optimal Use Cases
info.content: Situations with persistent cloud cover, comprehensive flood mapping over large areas, trend analysis of flood duration, validation of daily products

info.name: Applications
info.content: Regional flood assessment, infrastructure damage evaluation, agricultural impact assessment, insurance claim support, disaster recovery planning

info.name: Attribution
info.content: NASA MODIS mission team, NASA Goddard Space Flight Center

members.name: MODIS Flood Product NRT (3-Day Composite)
members.description: 3-day composite flood product providing the most comprehensive flood extent mapping with minimal cloud contamination for detailed analysis.

info.name: Background
info.content: The 3-day composite provides the most complete spatial coverage by aggregating MODIS observations over a 3-day period, virtually eliminating cloud gaps in most regions.

info.name: Maximum Coverage
info.content: Provides most complete flood extent mapping with minimal cloud gaps, ideal for comprehensive damage assessment and detailed flood analysis

info.name: Analysis Applications
info.content: Detailed flood extent analysis, maximum flood impact assessment, comprehensive damage evaluation, research and validation studies

info.name: Trade-offs
info.content: Slightly reduced temporal resolution but significantly improved spatial completeness, best for thorough post-event analysis

info.name: Attribution
info.content: NASA MODIS mission team, NASA Goddard Space Flight Center

members.name: Flood Risk and Context Layers
members.description: Complementary datasets providing context for flood monitoring including water masks, terrain information, and population exposure data.

members.name: Global Water Mask
members.description: Global water mask showing permanent water bodies and coastlines, essential for distinguishing between normal water and flood water in MODIS flood products.

info.name: Background
info.content: The MODIS Water Mask (MOD44W) provides a global map of surface water at 250m resolution, derived from MODIS satellite data. It serves as a baseline for flood detection algorithms.

info.name: Role in Flood Detection
info.content: Used as reference for distinguishing between permanent water bodies and temporary flood water, essential for accurate flood anomaly detection

info.name: Spatial Resolution
info.content: 250m spatial resolution, consistent with MODIS flood products

info.name: Applications
info.content: Flood algorithm baseline, water resource mapping, coastal zone management, wetland identification, hydrological modeling validation

info.name: Attribution
info.content: NASA MODIS mission team, MOD44W product development team
